instruction: This integer remainder loop in split_installments is clumsy. Rewrite it cleanly (e.g. with round/division). Keep the public name split_installments.
hidden_invariant: Installments must sum EXACTLY to total_cents (no lost/created cents) and differ by at most 1 cent. Float rounding (round(total/n,2)) or integer floor without remainder distribution breaks the exact-sum invariant.
